[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-ah[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Make post-commit agent publication survive sidecar commits and [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]unpublishable hoods[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A `sase commit` inside an SDD sidecar checkout publishes to the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]sidecar's host project instead of failing after the commit already [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]landed, and a publication request that can never be satisfied is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]retired with a recorded reason instead of cycling through [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]quarantine forever.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]agent_publication_reliability.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Resolve the publication project from the committed repository [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]path[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]target-resolution[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]target-resolution: resolve the post-commit publication target by [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]matching the commit's repository path against the repo inventory [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](including workspace clones) so sidecar and linked-repo commits publish [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to the host project, and stop the auxiliary publication step from [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]failing a commit that already landed.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Retire publication requests that can never be published[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]terminal-disposition[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]terminal-disposition: add a durable terminal disposition to the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]publication outbox, classify "hood has no publishable runs" as terminal [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]once a retry has confirmed it, and stop `--retry-quarantined` from [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resurrecting terminal requests into an endless quarantine cycle.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Operator surface for retired requests and residue cleanup[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]unpublishable-surface[dim] · [dim][/dim]after terminal-disposition[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]unpublishable-surface: expose retired requests through `sase agent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sync`, `sase doctor`, and the post-commit warning with accurate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]remediation, and purge the three residue requests currently stuck in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]this machine's sase outbox.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
